submission.implementation_notes: Compiled from Scala 3 (@Compile, Options.releaseUntagged). Computes every result at run time, with the recursion unrolled four times: factorial(n) = n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) * factorial(n - 4) for n >= 4, n(n-1) for n = 2 and 3, and 1 for every n <= 1, negatives included. No values are precomputed. factorial(12) takes three recursive calls instead of eleven.
